title: CSV Export
prompt: Write `toCsv(records, columns)` that RETURNS a CSV string: the first line is `columns` joined by commas, then one line per record with the value for each column — an empty string when the record is missing that field. Numbers are stringified. No trailing newline.

tests.name: header row matches the columns
tests.hint: Start with a lines array holding columns.join(',').

tests.name: missing fields become empty cells
tests.hint: Treat undefined and null as an empty string when mapping columns.

tests.name: numbers are stringified, no trailing newline
tests.hint: String(value) converts numbers; join lines with \n, not an extra push.
